headline: President Trump issued an order responding to steps taken by the law firm Paul, Weiss.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with actions the law firm Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison took to address concerns raised by the administration. It appears to change how the federal government treats the firm in light of those steps. No official summary was provided, so the specific terms are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Paul, Weiss law firm and its employees
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the federal government's treatment of the firm based on the steps the firm took, though the exact changes are not stated in the title.
